Prosocial Motivation Sensitivity Check

2025-12-09

1 Set up

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Load packages
library(dplyr)

library(simr)

library(car)

## The following object is masked from 'package:dplyr':
## 
##     recode
# Clear work space
rm(list = ls())

# Set system language
Sys.setenv(LANG = "en")

# Read file
task_filename <- "../Cleaned data/Prosocial_motivation_cleaned_data.csv"
mot_clean <- read.csv(task_filename, header = TRUE)

2 Prepare data

#---------------------------------
# Data prep
#---------------------------------
# Select variables for analysis
MEM_var <- mot_clean %>%
  select(
    # id, condition order, & controls
    participant_id,
    feedback_first,
    age,
    gender,
    income,
    
    #inspect the influence of prosociality
    prosociality,
    TriPM_total,
    
    # change goal variables
    change_goal_initial,
    change_goal_final,
    change_goal_pre_feedback,
    change_goal_post_feedback,
    change_goal_pre_psychoed,
    change_goal_post_psychoed
  )

3 Sensitivity test

Sensitivity Power Analysis via Monte Carlo Simulation Find the Minimum Detectable Effect Size (MDES) for the interaction term at 80% power

3.1 All Conditions

Find the MDES for the time_all_conditions * prosociality_z term at 80% power

sim_model_all_conditions <- lmer( change_z ~ time_all_conditions * prosociality_z + age_z + gender + income_z + (1 | participant_id), data = mot_all_z, control = ctrl )

#---------------------------------
# Prep
#---------------------------------
# Transform MEM_var from long to wide
mot_all <- MEM_var %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(change_goal_initial, change_goal_final),
    names_to = "time_all_conditions",
    values_to = "change_goal_all_condition"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time_all_conditions = dplyr::recode(
      time_all_conditions,
      change_goal_initial = "Initial",
      change_goal_final   = "Final"
    )
  )

# Factor time and reorder
mot_all$time_all_conditions <- factor(mot_all$time_all_conditions, levels = c("Initial", "Final"))

#---------------------------------
# Models
#---------------------------------
# ----- Standardize -----
mot_all_z <- mot_all

# z-score outcome + continuous predictors
mot_all_z$change_z        <- as.numeric(scale(mot_all_z$change_goal_all_condition))
mot_all_z$prosociality_z  <- as.numeric(scale(mot_all_z$prosociality))
mot_all_z$age_z           <- as.numeric(scale(mot_all_z$age))
mot_all_z$income_z        <- as.numeric(scale(mot_all_z$income))

# ----- Fit model -----
ctrl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))

sim_model_all_conditions <- lmer(
  change_z ~ time_all_conditions * prosociality_z + age_z + gender + income_z +
    (1 | participant_id),
  data    = mot_all_z,
  control = ctrl
)

#---------------------------------
# Simulation
#---------------------------------
# ----- Set up simulation -----
# Show progress bar
simrOptions(progress = TRUE)

# Extracts the fixed effect parameter names
int_term <- grep(":", names(fixef(sim_model_all_conditions)), value = TRUE)[1]
cat("Target interaction term:", int_term, "\n")
## Target interaction term: time_all_conditionsFinal:prosociality_z
# MDES search
betas_to_test <- c(0.35, 0.30, 0.25, 0.20, 0.15, 0.10)
mdes_results_all_conditions <- data.frame(beta = betas_to_test, power = NA, ci_lo = NA, ci_hi = NA)

for (i in seq_along(betas_to_test)) {
  b <- betas_to_test[i]
  fixef(sim_model_all_conditions)[int_term] <- b
  
  ps <- tryCatch(
    powerSim(sim_model_all_conditions, nsim = 1000, seed = 1, test = fixed(int_term, "sa")),
    error = function(e) { message("Sim failed at beta=", b, ": ", e$message); NULL }
  )
  
  if (!is.null(ps)) {
    s <- summary(ps)
    mdes_results_all_conditions$power[i] <- s$mean
    mdes_results_all_conditions$ci_lo[i] <- s$lower
    mdes_results_all_conditions$ci_hi[i] <- s$upper
  }
}

|Simulating: |==================================================================|
print(mdes_results_all_conditions)
##   beta power     ci_lo     ci_hi
## 1 0.35 0.998 0.9927942 0.9997577
## 2 0.30 0.990 0.9816868 0.9951945
## 3 0.25 0.951 0.9357339 0.9635329
## 4 0.20 0.829 0.8042047 0.8518402
## 5 0.15 0.566 0.5346248 0.5969855
## 6 0.10 0.298 0.2697813 0.3274133
# ----- Plot -----
ggplot(mdes_results_all_conditions, aes(x = beta, y = power)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi), alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_x_reverse() + # Reverses axis so beta goes from 0.10 -> 0.35
  labs(x = "Standardized interaction coefficient (beta)",
       y = "Estimated power",
       title = "Sensitivity Curve: N = 200") +
  theme_minimal()

# ----- Interpolate MDES at 80% power -----
clean_res <- na.omit(mdes_results_all_conditions)
fit80 <- approx(x = clean_res$power, y = clean_res$beta, xout = 0.80)
cat("\n---> Approximate MDES at 80% power: beta =", round(fit80$y, 3), "\n")
## 
## ---> Approximate MDES at 80% power: beta = 0.194

3.2 Feedback Conditions

Find the MDES for the time_feedback * prosociality_z term at 80% power

sim_model_feedback <- lmer( change_z ~ time_feedback * prosociality_z + age_z + gender + income_z + (1 | participant_id), data = mot_feedback_z, control = ctrl )

#---------------------------------
# Prep
#---------------------------------
# Transform MEM_var from long to wide
mot_feedback <- MEM_var %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(change_goal_pre_feedback, change_goal_post_feedback),
    names_to = "time_feedback",
    values_to = "change_goal_feedback"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time_feedback = dplyr::recode(
      time_feedback,
      change_goal_pre_feedback  = "Pre-feedback",
      change_goal_post_feedback = "Post-feedback"
    )
  )

# Factor time and reorder
mot_feedback$time_feedback <- factor(
  mot_feedback$time_feedback,
  levels = c("Pre-feedback", "Post-feedback")
)
# Keep only when the participant completed the feedback condition first
mot_feedback <- mot_feedback %>%
  filter(feedback_first == 1)

#---------------------------------
# Models
#---------------------------------
# ----- Standardize -----
mot_feedback_z <- mot_feedback

# z-score outcome + continuous predictors
mot_feedback_z$change_z        <- as.numeric(scale(mot_feedback_z$change_goal_feedback))
mot_feedback_z$prosociality_z  <- as.numeric(scale(mot_feedback_z$prosociality))
mot_feedback_z$age_z           <- as.numeric(scale(mot_feedback_z$age))
mot_feedback_z$income_z        <- as.numeric(scale(mot_feedback_z$income))

# ----- Fit model -----
ctrl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))

sim_model_feedback <- lmer(
  change_z ~ time_feedback * prosociality_z + age_z + gender + income_z + (1 | participant_id),
  data    = mot_feedback_z,
  control = ctrl
)

#---------------------------------
# Simulation
#---------------------------------
# ----- Set up simulation -----
# Show progress bar
simrOptions(progress = TRUE)

# Extracts the fixed effect parameter names
int_term <- grep(":", names(fixef(sim_model_feedback)), value = TRUE)[1]
cat("Target interaction term:", int_term, "\n")
## Target interaction term: time_feedbackPost-feedback:prosociality_z
# MDES search
betas_to_test <- c(0.35, 0.30, 0.25, 0.20, 0.15, 0.10)
mdes_results_feedback <- data.frame(beta = betas_to_test, power = NA, ci_lo = NA, ci_hi = NA)

for (i in seq_along(betas_to_test)) {
  b <- betas_to_test[i]
  fixef(sim_model_feedback)[int_term] <- b
  
  ps <- tryCatch(
    powerSim(sim_model_feedback, nsim = 1000, seed = 1, test = fixed(int_term, "sa")),
    error = function(e) { message("Sim failed at beta=", b, ": ", e$message); NULL }
  )
  
  if (!is.null(ps)) {
    s <- summary(ps)
    mdes_results_feedback$power[i] <- s$mean
    mdes_results_feedback$ci_lo[i] <- s$lower
    mdes_results_feedback$ci_hi[i] <- s$upper
  }
}
## Simulating: |                                                                  |Simulating: |=                                                                 |Simulating: |== print(mdes_results_feedback)
##   beta power     ci_lo     ci_hi
## 1 0.35 0.955 0.9402472 0.9669904
## 2 0.30 0.879 0.8571642 0.8985742
## 3 0.25 0.750 0.7219500 0.7765696
## 4 0.20 0.553 0.5215669 0.5841202
## 5 0.15 0.360 0.3301992 0.3906279
## 6 0.10 0.190 0.1661265 0.2157137
# ----- Plot -----
ggplot(mdes_results_feedback, aes(x = beta, y = power)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi), alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_x_reverse() + # Reverses axis so beta goes from 0.10 -> 0.35
  labs(x = "Standardized interaction coefficient (beta)",
       y = "Estimated power",
       title = "Sensitivity Curve: N = 200") +
  theme_minimal()

# ----- Interpolate MDES at 80% power -----
clean_res <- na.omit(mdes_results_feedback)
fit80 <- approx(x = clean_res$power, y = clean_res$beta, xout = 0.80)
cat("\n---> Approximate MDES at 80% power: beta =", round(fit80$y, 3), "\n")

3.3 Psychoed Conditions

Find the MDES for the time_psychoed * prosociality_z term at 80% power

sim_model_psychoed <- lmer( change_z ~ time_psychoed * prosociality_z + age_z + gender + income_z + (1 | participant_id), data = mot_psychoed_z, control = ctrl )

#---------------------------------
# Prep
#---------------------------------
# Transform MEM_var from long to wide
mot_psychoed <- MEM_var %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(change_goal_pre_psychoed, change_goal_post_psychoed),
    names_to = "time_psychoed",
    values_to = "change_goal_psychoed"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time_psychoed = dplyr::recode(
      time_psychoed,
      change_goal_pre_psychoed  = "Pre-psychoed",
      change_goal_post_psychoed = "Post-psychoed"
    )
  )

# Factor time and reorder
mot_psychoed$time_psychoed <- factor(mot_psychoed$time_psychoed,
                                         levels = c("Pre-psychoed", "Post-psychoed"))
# Keep only when the participant completed the psychoed condition first
mot_psychoed <- mot_psychoed %>%
  filter(feedback_first == 0)

#---------------------------------
# Models
#---------------------------------
# ----- Standardize -----
mot_psychoed_z <- mot_psychoed

# z-score outcome + continuous predictors
mot_psychoed_z$change_z        <- as.numeric(scale(mot_psychoed_z$change_goal_psychoed))
mot_psychoed_z$prosociality_z  <- as.numeric(scale(mot_psychoed_z$prosociality))
mot_psychoed_z$age_z           <- as.numeric(scale(mot_psychoed_z$age))
mot_psychoed_z$income_z        <- as.numeric(scale(mot_psychoed_z$income))

# ----- Fit model -----
ctrl <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))

sim_model_psychoed <- lmer(
  change_z ~ time_psychoed * prosociality_z + age_z + gender + income_z + (1 | participant_id),
  data    = mot_psychoed_z,
  control = ctrl
)

#---------------------------------
# Simulation
#---------------------------------
# ----- Set up simulation -----
# Show progress bar
simrOptions(progress = TRUE)

# Extracts the fixed effect parameter names
int_term <- grep(":", names(fixef(sim_model_psychoed)), value = TRUE)[1]
cat("Target interaction term:", int_term, "\n")
## Target interaction term: time_psychoedPost-psychoed:prosociality_z
# MDES search
betas_to_test <- c(0.35, 0.30, 0.25, 0.20, 0.15, 0.10)
mdes_results_psychoed <- data.frame(beta = betas_to_test, power = NA, ci_lo = NA, ci_hi = NA)

for (i in seq_along(betas_to_test)) {
  b <- betas_to_test[i]
  fixef(sim_model_psychoed)[int_term] <- b
  
  ps <- tryCatch(
    powerSim(sim_model_psychoed, nsim = 1000, seed = 1, test = fixed(int_term, "sa")),
    error = function(e) { message("Sim failed at beta=", b, ": ", e$message); NULL }
  )
  
  if (!is.null(ps)) {
    s <- summary(ps)
    mdes_results_psychoed$power[i] <- s$mean
    mdes_results_psychoed$ci_lo[i] <- s$lower
    mdes_results_psychoed$ci_hi[i] <- s$upper
  }
}

|Simulating: |=============================================================== |Simulating: |================================================================= |==================================================================|
print(mdes_results_psychoed)
##   beta power     ci_lo     ci_hi
## 1 0.35 0.919 0.9003283 0.9351565
## 2 0.30 0.814 0.7884716 0.8376640
## 3 0.25 0.656 0.6256313 0.6854469
## 4 0.20 0.445 0.4138991 0.4764256
## 5 0.15 0.284 0.2562212 0.3130567
## 6 0.10 0.139 0.1181459 0.1620045
# ----- Plot -----
ggplot(mdes_results_psychoed, aes(x = beta, y = power)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi), alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_x_reverse() + # Reverses axis so beta goes from 0.10 -> 0.35
  labs(x = "Standardized interaction coefficient (beta)",
       y = "Estimated power",
       title = "Sensitivity Curve: N = 200") +
  theme_minimal()

# ----- Interpolate MDES at 80% power -----
clean_res <- na.omit(mdes_results_psychoed)
fit80 <- approx(x = clean_res$power, y = clean_res$beta, xout = 0.80)
cat("\n---> Approximate MDES at 80% power: beta =", round(fit80$y, 3), "\n")
## 
## ---> Approximate MDES at 80% power: beta = 0.296
